minimumImplementationDirection.recommendation: Add one pure, non-persistent overallCreditPoints(verifiedAttempts) helper that sums each verified correct attempt’s existing earnedPoints and contributes zero for partial/incorrect. Keep denominator and unanswered policy with each current owner. Extend existing Certification Practice, Certification Exam, and Coding completed-result projections that already validate attempts. Do not create a universal score loader or a new Design Interview verifier. Where an existing generic/historical summary has no compatible verified attempts, keep its current count summary readable and omit the optional points row; for Certification Practice, keep current summary availability/validation separate from an optional derived-points lookup.

minimumImplementationDirection.historicalRead: Do not persist a new score or rewrite old evidence. Existing family projections derive the display numerator from attempts they already validate; raw result points remain checked against the raw canonical scorer. If an optional Certification Practice derived-points lookup fails, keep its existing count summary and omit the points row. For generic historical summaries with no compatible verified attempts, preserve current summary availability and count score, omitting only unsupported raw points. Never fall back to raw earnedPoints or guess a weighted numerator from aggregate counts.

ResultScreen, AlgorithmsPracticeSummaryScreen, AlgorithmsInterviewSimulationResultScreen, and SessionResultOverview tests cover actual points rows and the generic-summary no-points-row case; progressTabModel tests cover per-area totals and effectiveness.

minimumImplementationDirection.helperRule: For each already verified attempt, include result.earnedPoints iff result.kind === correct; otherwise include zero. The helper is pure and does not choose/change a denominator or persisted evidence.
minimumImplementationDirection.designSummaryPolicy: The Object-Oriented Design catalog is choice_single-only, so it cannot produce partial outcomes. The generic Design result branch can also represent other tracks; do not assume all of its sessions are single-choice. Do not add a new Design completed-result verifier for this score change. Where no compatible verified attempts exist, preserve the count summary and omit its optional raw-points row.
minimumImplementationDirection.historicalFallback: Do not reject a currently readable generic or Certification Practice summary because optional derived points cannot be computed. Keep existing summary validation/availability behavior; omit only the optional weighted-points row when there is no compatible verified attempt projection.
minimumImplementationDirection.codingPracticeScreen: AlgorithmsPracticeSummaryScreen consumes getAlgorithmsPracticeSummaryProjection and normalizes its validated result.score into the shared weighted-points row. Feed that row derived correct-only credit from the existing validated projection; preserve its denominator and raw evidence validation.

limitations: This is a read-only preflight; no implementation, native-device, Premium, full-Q12, full-BIZQ-01, or release-readiness acceptance is claimed.

CertificationPractice raw result evidence does not encode the per-attempt max points needed to reconstruct a correct-only weighted numerator. A future implementation must derive from verified attempts or avoid presenting raw points as overall credit; do not guess from aggregate counts.
No Learning Plan weighted-point consumer was found in the searched application and feature paths; retain this as a bounded search finding rather than a whole-repository claim.

No Design completed-result verifier is proposed: the current Object-Oriented Design catalog is single-choice only. Other generic historical result summaries remain readable if optional points cannot be derived; only that points row is omitted.
